full_text:
Paola is a member of the Huntik Foundation who looks after a safehouse where Foundation Seekers may rest or take refuge.

== Personality ==
Paola is a kind and friendly Seeker who tries to look after those who come to her sanctuary. [TCG: LGS-038]

== Abilities ==
Paola possesses powers which are mysterious including her "Mystic Aura" which she uses to protect her and her allies. Able to control the irrepressible and unstable Titan, Madea, Paola has a strong will. [TCG: LGS-038]
